cards.card_text: On the Damascus road, Paul asks, "Who are You, Lord?" The Lord answers that He is ___, the one Paul is persecuting.
cards.verse_text: ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
cards.snippet: ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.

cards.card_text: As to zeal, Paul says he was persecuting the church.
cards.verse_text: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
